lines: Unpracticed in prāṇa-conduct, how will he perform this? The to-be-spok
l4.sanskrit_cite: anabhyastaprāṇacāraḥ kathamenāṃ kariṣyati vakṣyamāṇāṃ brahmavidyāṃ sakalāṃ niṣkalombhitām
